address: The Principal York Hotel, Station Road, York,YO24 1AA
bio: Housed within a Grade II listed building, the stunning Principal York Hotel is situated in the heart of York, adjacent to York Train Station.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Garden Room, featuring elegant interiors, luxury soft furnishings, and an abundance of natural light. This tranquil setting offers guests the opportunity to enjoy Afternoon Tea while admiring the picturesque views of York Minster with landscaped gardens in the foreground.  Inspired by York’s well-renowned history with chocolate, Executive Chef Aaron Craig has crafted and developed a truly magical indulgence of mouth-watering sweet treats that evoke nostalgia for the nation’s favourite chocolates.   Elevate your afternoon tea experience to new heights of indulgence and embark on a tantalising sensory adventure that celebrates York’s chocolate heritage.
